{{Article header|deck=The actionable checklist for gaining access to Domino Green — for location, capabilities, blueprints, and other reference details, see the Engineer article.}}

This Field Procedure covers only the steps to unlock [[Domino Green]]. For the Engineer's location, specialties, available blueprints, experimental effects, and reference details, see [[Domino Green]].

== Objective ==
Gain access to [[Domino Green]]'s Engineer services in Orishis.

== Prerequisites ==
{{Prerequisites|
* '''Discovery:''' Domino Green is '''common knowledge''' and does not require a referral from another Engineer.
* '''Invitation:''' There is no separate invitation requirement for Domino Green.
}}

== Required Materials, Equipment, and Access ==
'''Obtaining Push'''
Push is a physical Odyssey '''Good''' described as a recreational drug.

Current material data lists Push at:

* '''Irregular Markers''' points of interest; and
* '''surface crash sites'''.

Because Push is a physical Good rather than Data, the five doses must be carried and handed directly to Domino.

Push is not currently used in ordinary suit or weapon modification recipes; its Engineering-progression use is Domino's referral to Kit Fowler.

{{Tip|If you intend to continue this branch, reserve the first '''5 Push''' you obtain rather than selling or discarding them.}}

Bartender trade offers may also provide a way to obtain Push when appropriate offers are available, but bartender inventories and trade opportunities can vary.

Once the five doses have been provided, [[Kit Fowler]] becomes known.

== Step-by-Step Procedure ==
{{Procedure steps|
# Visit a station or settlement with an Apex Interstellar counter.
# Book an Apex shuttle to another system.
# Continue using Apex until your cumulative shuttle travel reaches at least '''100 light-years'''.
# Travel to '''The Jackrabbit''' on '''Orishis 4'''.
# Access Domino Green's Engineer workshop.
}}

== Expected Result ==
{{Expected result|[[Domino Green]] is unlocked and available for Engineering services at their workshop.}}
